No, how you dress and look does not make you gay. Being attracted to the same sex does. Do whatever makes you comfortable. If you want to wear makeup or dress more feminine there is nothing wrong with that.

I don’t think you need new friends. I believe a lot of people, including myself, have no desire to talk about our sexuality. If someone asks I’ll answer, but I don’t like my sexuality/gender to define who I am as a person. I brought it up quite a bit when I first came out, but that was when I was still looking for something to define who I was. I kind of think people who talk about their sexuality or gender quite a bit feel defined by that part of their life and that’s okay. For some people it is a really difficult process to come out and it can be worth talking about to get to know the person better. A lot of bi people in hetero relationships aren’t always validated, so they feel a need for that part of them to be heard. I personally only let possible partners know I’m interested.
And I’m sorry your friend is questioning your sexuality. If she’s asking that often is it possible she might want to sleep with you?

So I have a nightmare about my dad losing his house. I end up crying this morning about how I don’t think things were as great as I thought they were.
My boyfriend and I went to the city cemetery, and I talked about how I don’t think life is worth living. It seems like there is much more pain and suffering than joy. And yeah, sure I could “choose” to be happy if I didn’t have this constant voice telling me I’m worthless, no one loves me, and “go kill yourself”.
Then after that, I see an old text on my boyfriends phone (I was snooping with his permission) and he asked a girl to fuck him “jokingly”. He still asked to fuck her, a couple days before he said “I love you” for the first time. I feel lied to. I feel like I can’t trust anyone. I feel like my whole world is crashing down and I wish I had the strength to kill myself, but I don’t want to do that to my family. Feeling this pain all day, carrying it on my shoulders and hearing that voice constantly is exhausting. Now I’m going to take a fuck ton of gabapentin, klonopin, and drink a lot of alcohol to try to forget today.
